prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Beijing in a storybook gaslamp-fantasy steampunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy Beijing on a soft golden evening: narrow hutong lanes of grey-brick courtyard houses with red-lacquered gates, gas lamps and red silk lanterns glowing side by side; at the end of the lane the tall two-storey drum tower and, behind it, the grey-walled bell tower with its green glazed roof; a brass steam rickshaw puffing clean white steam past the willows; out on the palace lake a pavilion-boat of white marble with brass paddlewheels turning in soft steam; silk kites and airships with lantern-shaped balloons drifting over the golden palace roofs in the distance.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Avoid: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, hologram, digital display, touchscreen, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, soot, grime, rust, coal smoke, sweat stains, photographic texture.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
